question: What native context-pressure contract should OpenClaw support for saturated child sessions: observe-only alerting, parent-routed recovery, or automatic recovery?
rationale: The current code has usage data and subagent lineage metadata, but it does not define threshold semantics, parent notification targets, operator alert delivery, or recovery behavior; automation should not invent that product/API contract.

options.title: Design narrow health contract
options.body: Define threshold semantics, parent identity, operator notification target, and recovery mode first, then implement the smallest diagnostic/session-health path around that contract.

options.title: Document external monitoring only
options.body: Keep core behavior unchanged and document /status or session-row polling for fleet operators who want custom monitors.

options.title: Jump to automatic recovery
options.body: Add built-in threshold-triggered parent notification and recovery immediately, accepting new config/API surface and behavior risk without a prior contract.

recommendation.title: Design narrow health contract
recommendation.body: Define threshold semantics, parent identity, operator notification target, and recovery mode first, then implement the smallest diagnostic/session-health path around that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans Agents and Telemetry/diagnostics, both listed for vincentkoc in CONTRIBUTING.md, with Tyler's subagent history as important review context.
